interruptions.kind: pause requested by the user, to resume on a later day
interruptions.note: The partial block is rerun from scratch on resume (never merged); completed blocks are reused by --resume. The first Stop-Process call did not terminate the process; taskkill /F did, about 20 minutes after the user decided to pause, so the partial block had progressed further than when the pause was proposed.
